In this notebook, I will make plots for Main Figure 7

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpmisc)
library(ggseqlogo)
library(Seurat)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

colNM <- "#6b6a6a"
colNOA <- "#bfbfbf"
colFR <- "#11d6cc"
colPR <- "#ff8c00"
colNR <- "#ff1e00"
atnfColVec <- c("NM"=colNM, "NOA"=colNOA,"FR"=colFR,"PR"=colPR,"NR"=colNR)

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))

alakazamfeatures <- c("Hydrophobicity", "Size", "Aliphatic", "Polarity")

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")
```

```{r}
alakazam <- read_csv("out/tcr/alakazam/cdr3b_mr_alakazam_scored_241120.csv")
alakazam

obs <- obs %>%
  mutate(cdr3.len = nchar(cdr3.TRB)) %>%
  mutate(cdr3mr = ifelse(cdr3.len >= 12 & cdr3.len <= 17, substr(cdr3.TRB, 5, nchar(cdr3.TRB) - 6), NA))
  
obs <- obs %>% 
  left_join(alakazam, by = "cdr3mr") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cdr3mr)) %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = c(cdr3mr_aa_gravy, cdr3mr_aa_bulk, cdr3mr_aa_aliphatic, cdr3mr_aa_polarity),
      .fns = ~(ifelse(!is.na(cdr3mr), (. - mean(., na.rm = T))/sd(., na.rm = T), NA)),
      # .fns = ~(. - mean(., na.rm = T)/sd(., na.rm = T)),
      .names = "{.col}.norm"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Hydrophobicity = cdr3mr_aa_gravy.norm, Size = cdr3mr_aa_bulk.norm, Aliphatic = cdr3mr_aa_aliphatic.norm, Polarity = cdr3mr_aa_polarity.norm) %>% 
  select(cdr3mr, Hydrophobicity, Size, Aliphatic, Polarity) %>% 
  distinct(cdr3mr, .keep_all = T, by = "cdr3mr") %>% 
  left_join(obs, .)

obs %>% filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRB))
```

# Logo plot

```{r, fig.retina=TRUE, fig.width=21, fig.height=15}
ggseqlogo(
  obs %>% 
    mutate(length = nchar(cdr3.TRB)) %>% 
    filter(length == 15 & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>%
    filter(tgroup == "CD4T") %>% 
    filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
    pull(cdr3.TRB),
  seq_type = "aa",
  method = "prob",
  col_scheme = "chemistry"
) + 
  labs(
    x = "CDR3β Position"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 60, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 60, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

# Alakazam

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  obs %>% filter(timepoint == "T0" & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>% droplevels,
  features = c("Hydrophobicity", "Size", "Aliphatic", "Polarity"),
  filterCol = "tgroup",
  filterVal = "CD4T",
  ncol = 2,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 50,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  yLab = "Mean AA Composition Score",
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(.,
         aes(x = diagSub, y = meanVal)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), shape = 21, size = 3, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  facet_wrap(~featureVar, scales = "fixed", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp, label.y = c(0.29, 0.33, 0.37, 0.41),
                     label = "p.format", vjust = 1.75, size = 4, tip.length = 0.025) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    y = "Mean Normalized Middle-Region Score\n(CD4T Cells)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

### Expansion


```{r}
obs.exp <- obs %>% 
  filter(celltype == "TNKILC") %>% 
  group_by(biopsy, cdr3.TRA) %>% 
  mutate(count.cdr3a = n()) %>% 
  mutate(count.cdr3a = ifelse(is.na(cdr3.TRA), NA, count.cdr3a)) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy, cdr3.TRB) %>% 
  mutate(count.cdr3b = n()) %>% 
  mutate(count.cdr3b = ifelse(is.na(cdr3.TRB), NA, count.cdr3b)) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3 = paste(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3 = ifelse(cdr3 == "NA_NA", NA, cdr3)) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy, cdr3) %>% 
  mutate(count.cdr3 = n()) %>% 
  mutate(count.cdr3 = ifelse(is.na(cdr3.TRA) | is.na(cdr3.TRB), NA, count.cdr3)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(expanded.alpha = case_when(
    count.cdr3a > 1 ~ "Expanded",
    count.cdr3a == 1 ~ "Singlet",
    is.na(count.cdr3a) ~ NA
  )) %>% 
  mutate(expanded.beta = case_when(
    count.cdr3b > 1 ~ "Expanded",
    count.cdr3b == 1 ~ "Singlet",
    is.na(count.cdr3b) ~ NA
  )) %>% 
  mutate(expanded.paired = case_when(
    count.cdr3 > 1 ~ "Expanded",
    count.cdr3 == 1 ~ "Singlet",
    is.na(count.cdr3) ~ NA
  ))
  

obs.exp %>% filter(cellstate == "PD1Hi Tfh") %>%  select(cdr3.TRA, count.cdr3a, expanded.alpha) %>% filter(!is.na(expanded.alpha))
obs.exp %>% filter(cellstate == "PD1Hi Tfh") %>%  select(cdr3.TRB, count.cdr3b, expanded.beta) %>% filter(!is.na(expanded.beta))
obs.exp %>% filter(cellstate == "PD1Hi Tfh") %>%  select(cdr3, count.cdr3, expanded.paired) %>% filter(!is.na(expanded.paired))
```

```{r, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=5}
obs.exp %>% 
  filter(cellstate == "PD1Hi Tfh") %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(count.cdr3)) %>%

  group_by(diagSub, expanded.paired, cellstate, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(mTiRP, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(mTiRP, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = expanded.paired, y = mTiRP, fill = expanded.paired)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se, color = diagSub), color = "black", width=0.3, linewidth=1, position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0)) +

  guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
  labs(

  ) +
  theme_light() +
```

### Anti-TNF

```{r, fig.width=2.75, fig.height=4.5}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  obs %>% filter(diagSub == "UC" & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>% droplevels,
  features = "mTiRP",
  relative.to = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("PD1Hi Tfh"),
  ncol = 2,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 50,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  yLab = "Mean AA Composition Score",
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, antitnf_response, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = ifelse(timepoint == "T0", "PreTx", "PostTx")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("PreTx", "PostTx"))) %>%
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, fig.retina=TRUE}
SenderReceiver(
  obs %>% 
    filter(diagSub != "iCD" & timepoint == "T0") %>% 
    mutate(cellstate.b = ifelse(cellstate %in% c("GC-like BC", "Prlf. BC"), "TLS-like BC", as.character(cellstate))) %>% 
    mutate(cellstate.b = as.factor(cellstate.b)) %>% 
    mutate(cellstate.tfh = ifelse(cellstate == "PD1Hi Tfh" & !is.na(cdr3.TRB), "PD1Hi Tfh", "Other")) %>% 
    mutate(cellstate.tfh = fct_relevel(cellstate.tfh, c("PD1Hi Tfh", "Other"))) %>% 
    droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",
  senderCol = "cellstate.tfh",
  senderVal = "PD1Hi Tfh",
  features.sender = "mTiRP",
  senderProp = FALSE,
  senderRelative = "cellstate",
  minSenderFreq = 50,
  receiverCol = "cellstate.b",
  receiverVal = "TLS-like BC",
  receiverProp = TRUE,
  receiverRelative = "celltype",
  minReceiverFreq = 10,
  xVar = "diagSub",
  fillVar = "antitnf_response",
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = senderExp, y = prop.receiver)) +
  stat_poly_line(method = "lm") +
  stat_poly_eq(method = "lm", use_label(c("R2", "P")), size = 4.5, vjust=0.5, rsquared.conf.level = 0.999) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), size = 3.5, shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) +
  facet_grid(~diagSub, scales = "free") +
  guides(
    fill = "none",
    color = "none"
    ) +
  labs(
    x = "PD1Hi Tfh Mean mTiRP Score", 
    y = "TLS-like BC % (Relative to B Cells)", 
    size = "# Cells", 
    shape = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),

    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm")
  )
```
